title: Handlebar Dash
tagline: A round digital dash on its own handlebar clamp, replacing the stock instruments.
summary: A 2.8" round colour display in a classic round gauge, with the tell-tales (turn signals, high beam, neutral, ABS, engine, fuel, battery) lit in its own face. It reads the bike's own signals (speed, fuel, gear, indicators, warning lights) and adds GPS speed and trip, clock, battery voltage, air temperature, lean angle and g-force. A standard OBD-II port and three expansion slots let it grow. First bike: the J-platform 350 with the J1D3 harness (the Meteor 350).
status: Phase 1 (learning the bike's CAN bus) is ready to build, and the display head is modelled (v1, checked in CAD, not printed yet): a round gauge, 102.5 mm across, the screen in the centre, the logo and the 8 tell-tales on the display's own black glass border, on the handlebar: two slim clamps bolted straight to its back, on rubber, hidden behind it. The interface box comes next.

Components: the exact parts (Amazon.in / Flipkart first)
Phase 1: the CAN logger, wiring, ride plan and measurements

see_sub: A classic round gauge on the handlebar, the screen in the centre. The face ring lies on the display's own black glass border, so the logo and the tell-tales sit on that border: the housing adds only its 3 mm wall. Two slim clamps on the bar, right beside the bike's own clamp, bolt straight to its back on rubber pads, and the gauge sits where it hides them from the seat. 102.5 mm across, 43 mm deep.

gallery.caption: From the rider's seat: the screen in the centre, the logo and the lit tell-tales round the top, a silver trim ring, and no mount in sight: its clamps hide behind the gauge

The face: the logo at the top; turn left, high beam, neutral and ABS on its left, engine, low fuel, battery and turn right on its right, all on the display's black glass border. Each icon is filled flush with clear resin over its own RGB LED
Customise it: your own logo (a word, or an SVG file), which icons and how many, their size, or the logo only
From the side: a slim clamp on the 22.2 mm bar beside the bike's own clamp (grey: a stand-in; measure yours), bolted straight to the gauge's back on a rubber pad
From in front of the bike: the two slim clamps either side of the bike's clamp, and an optional logo on the back cover (an example word; empty by default)
Option: bolted where the stock cluster was, on its bracket, with a printed adapter
Taken apart: the trim ring, the shell, the carrier (the display screws to it), the back cover, the 2 bar clamps with their rubber pads and caps

part_groups.label: Where the stock cluster was: the adapter

head_shell.name: Shell (with tell-tales)
head_shell.what: The round gauge: the screen's window in the centre; on the face ring, the logo engraved at the top and the 8 tell-tale windows either side of it, with pockets behind for their LED boards
head_shell.material: Black PETG (ASA for the final part). Face down, no supports; 0.2 mm first layers for crisp icons

head_shell_plain.name: Shell (plain face)
head_shell_plain.what: The same gauge with the logo only (the tell-tales show on the screen)
head_shell_plain.material: Black PETG (ASA for the final part). Face down

trim_ring.name: Trim ring
trim_ring.what: The ring around the face's edge: glue it into the rebate
trim_ring.material: Silver (or any contrast colour) PETG or ASA. Flat

head_carrier.name: Carrier
head_carrier.what: The display screws to it (4 x M2 x 6 into its own standoffs); the GPS module and the CAN board go on its back, the GPS antenna at the top behind it

head_cover.name: Back cover
head_cover.what: The back cover: 4 holes for the bar clamps' bolts (M4 x 14, from inside, into the clamps' feet), the GX12 socket at the top

head_cover_cluster.name: Back cover (cluster mount)
head_cover_cluster.what: The back cover with 2 M4 inserts for the cluster adapter
head_cover_cluster.material: PETG (ASA for the final part). Plug's front edge on the bed

head_cover_stalk.name: Back cover (stalk)
head_cover_stalk.what: As the back cover, with the GoPro-style 3-prong joint instead of the cradle's inserts
head_cover_stalk.material: PETG, 4 perimeters (the joint). Plug edge down, joint up

lip_gasket.name: Foam ring
lip_gasket.what: 0.8 mm ring between the face ring and the glass's black border. Print in TPU, or cut it from 0.8 mm closed-cell foam

cluster_adapter.name: Cluster adapter
cluster_adapter.what: Bolts the gauge where the stock instrument cluster was, hidden behind it: its foot to the stock cluster bracket's holes (M6 bolts from below into captive nuts, through the bracket's own rubber grommets), its pad to the cover's 2 M4 inserts. MEASURE your bracket first: its sizes are placeholders
cluster_adapter.material: PETG or ASA, 100% infill near the holes. Foot on the bed, no supports

bar_mount_right.name: Bar clamp, right
bar_mount_right.what: A slim bar clamp's upper half, right beside your bike's handlebar clamp, with a solid block straight back to a foot on the gauge's back cover. 2 M4 inserts from below (the clamp bolts) and 2 in the foot (the cover bolts)
bar_mount_right.material: PETG or ASA, 100% infill. On the clamp's inner face; support under the block

bar_mount_left.name: Bar clamp, left
bar_mount_left.what: The same, mirrored, for the left side
bar_mount_left.material: PETG or ASA, 100% infill. On the clamp's inner face; support under the block

cradle_cap.name: Clamp caps
cradle_cap.what: The bar clamps' lower halves, with a 1 mm rubber strip in each clamp: 2 x M4 x 20 bolts each, up from below into the inserts

mount_pad.name: Rubber pads
mount_pad.what: 2 mm pads between each clamp's foot and the cover, for damping. Cut them from 2 mm rubber sheet (this is the shape), or print in TPU. Mirror the second

clamp_upper.name: Stalk clamp, upper
clamp_upper.what: Around the bar, with the 2 fingers of the joint (fits the cover's 3)

clamp_lower.name: Stalk clamp, lower
clamp_lower.what: The other half, with traps for 2 M4 nuts

head_assembled_cluster.name: Assembled: where the stock cluster was
head_assembled_cluster.what: The whole gauge on the cluster adapter (the grey plate stands in for your bike's cluster bracket)

head_assembled.name: Assembled: on the handlebar
head_assembled.what: The whole gauge on its 2 bar clamps (the grey block stands in for your bike's handlebar clamp)

head_assembled_stalk.name: Display head on a stalk, assembled
head_assembled_stalk.what: The head on the GoPro-style joint (view only)
